name: Klaviyo
one_liner: Marketing platform for email, SMS and push with a broad REST API, SDKs, webhooks and an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Private API keys (pk_ prefix, Custom/Read-only/Full scopes) for /api; OAuth for apps used by other accounts and required for the App Marketplace; public key for client endpoints. A revision header is required.
access_notes: A free plan exists. Creating a private key needs an Owner, Admin or Manager role. A linked test account can be created (starts on the free plan). Marketplace listing requires OAuth.
sandbox_or_test_env: test account: a regular Klaviyo account with a test label, starts on free plan, same production environment

buildability.rationale: Self-serve scoped keys on a free plan, OpenAPI-described broad REST API (Campaigns 59, Catalogs 55, Custom Objects 39 endpoints, Webhooks 7), documented tiered rate limits, SDKs and an official MCP.

identity.quote: Use the Klaviyo MCP server to work with an account's data from an AI assistant or agent

auth.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth

access.quote: Up to 250 active profiles and 500 emails per month
Creating an API key takes an Owner, Admin or Manager role on the account.

sandbox.quote: A test account is a regular Klaviyo account with a test label.

api_surface.quote: Klaviyo offers SDKs for server-side languages (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node)

disputes.why: Free plan exists and private keys are self-created in Settings.
Docs describe OAuth for apps and the Marketplace.
Reference lists many resources with dozens of endpoints each (59, 55, 39).
Reference lists a Webhooks resource with 7 endpoints.
Rate limits page documents burst and steady tiers.
Official docs and OpenAPI spec exist.
